verdict.rationale: Next.js has a built-in MCP endpoint that gives coding agents access to a running app, so agent credential scoping is a fair question here. However, nothing in the evidence shows the framework issuing scoped or least-privilege API credentials. Its middleware access rules and API routes are developer building blocks for building auth, not a credential-issuance capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
